establishedStudentGranularity.catalogReuse: Edition/unit/page/question catalogs are shared entities; effective-dated student book assignments and student histories link to them. Do not duplicate entire catalogs per student or per week.
establishedStudentGranularity.studentPartitioning: Individual student databases means logical student-keyed records in shared tables with verified owner/student/lesson keys. It does not mean one SQLite/D1/Postgres database, one schema or one Sheet tab per student. The shared edition catalog and entity/revision references remain common across those records.
establishedStudentGranularity.identity: Keep verified opaque source keys as strings, preserving leading zeros and exact occurrence/attempt/revision IDs. Names, titles, row positions and printed labels are display values, never identity joins. Existing stableId uses canonical tuples and namespaces.
establishedStudentGranularity.printedPages: Printed page labels are distinct from one-based PDF file pages and may be nonnumeric. A sample PDF does not establish complete question inventory or student assignment.
evidence: Source observation, source record identity, contract reference and source/observation timestamps
Assigned work versus actual attempts, reported completion and explicit teacher inspection
Per-question grading and wrong-item/correction-review evidence when an exact item contract exists
Teacher present/future plans, approvals, cancellation and evidence basis
Teacher notes, model drafts, reviews and corrections with append-only revisions
Original media links and original SPT event/capture/import/chunk/receipt identities
establishedStudentGranularity.unknowns: Knowledge values retain evidence references or an explicit unknown reason. Unknown occurrence, app identity, edition, page, question, grade or teacher inspection is never filled by approximation. A scalar grade on a multi-question scope cannot be copied to each question.
establishedStudentGranularity.history: Preserve full payload snapshots, actor, recordedAt, reason, entity sequence, previous revision/digest and retry key. Reverting a value appends a compensating revision; it does not erase history.
establishedStudentGranularity.retention: Existing user intent keeps instructor notes, model drafts and review/correction history without a fixed time limit. Raw academy exports, authentication and original audio have separate boundaries; this is not unlimited raw-data retention permission.

recommendation.now: Use built-in bun:sqlite for the synthetic repository/test persistence adapter. It adds no package, service, credential or billing dependency and exercises the existing learning contract durably across file reopen.
recommendation.hostedDecision: Deferred to the next session because the clarified scope includes atomic mathematical prerequisite knowledge graphs and an ontology spanning academy backend and personal graph evidence. Compare PostgreSQL plus an explicit ontology/graph layer, graph databases and hybrid options against that actual purpose before selecting a provider. selectedHostedProvider remains null.
recommendation.priorD1Recommendation: The earlier D1-first recommendation was based on the existing SPT SQLite/D1/R2 architecture and learning-revision scope. It is now provisional and is not the default for the expanded Knowledge Graph/ontology purpose. Preserve existing SPT D1/R2 authority without blindly reusing production tables. No per-student physical databases are proposed.
recommendation.postgresCandidate: PostgreSQL is a promising base for transactional identities, learning evidence, revisions, relational joins and ontology-associated records. Its suitability for versioned concepts, prerequisite traversal and personal knowledge graphs must be compared deliberately with graph-oriented storage and a separate ontology layer; no provider or implementation direction is settled here.
recommendation.sheetsTransition: Keep hidden Park auxiliary tabs as a compatibility source until all exact consumers have migrated and readbacks/recovery are verified. Hiding is a UI operation and does not improve database transactions or erase existing formulas/consumers. Do not delete tabs or move records simply to claim one-sheet operation.
recommendation.efficiencyEvidence: No live latency, volume or concurrency measurement was taken. The reason to develop a database is explicit hierarchical joins, atomic revision/idempotency invariants and maintainable history, not an unmeasured claim that hiding itself is inefficient.
recommendation.notProductionStorage: Codex Cloud task files and a published development-environment snapshot are not a durable shared production database or always-running scheduled-refresh host. A synthetic SQLite file in this workspace can be lost with task/environment replacement and must never become the sole copy of student records.

syntheticPrototype.scope: Only invented data in :memory: or explicit .synthetic.sqlite development files, with synthetic: namespace markers. Markers document purpose; they cannot detect private content or provide access control.
syntheticPrototype.atomicWrite: BEGIN IMMEDIATE holds the local SQLite writer boundary while reloading full namespace history, validating it, recomputing preview/CAS, appending and reading back. Failures roll back. Busy/uncertain failures do not mint a new retry key.
syntheticPrototype.appendOnly: SQLite triggers reject UPDATE/DELETE on revision rows. Corrections and compensations append new records. Full history validates domain hash chains and duplicate indexed identities before projection.
syntheticPrototype.isolation: All store queries and uniqueness constraints include an explicit namespace. This is logical test partitioning, not authenticated production tenant isolation.
syntheticPrototype.portability: Logical schemaVersion=1 exports preserve exact revision envelopes and full cross-entity append order, counts and a canonical digest; import requires an empty matching namespace and verifies readback in the same transaction. SQLite rowids are excluded.
syntheticPrototype.upgradePolicy: Refuse an unrelated nonempty database or unsupported user_version; no implicit upgrade, merge, deletion or mapping rewrite.
syntheticPrototype.integrityLimits: Unkeyed digests and local triggers detect ordinary inconsistency; they do not authenticate a writer or detect an attacker who rewrites schema/digests or truncates history. Production needs independent trusted heads/receipts, authorization and backup policy. The prototype validates the whole partition and is not a measured large-scale indexed-query implementation.
notImplemented: Access control, signed audit or production backup service
